Kiosk page at /kiosk/{property_id}/{outlet_id} has dark theme (bg-stone-900) 3-panel layout
Kiosk idle/welcome screen shows hotel name, outlet name, 'Tap anywhere to start ordering'
Kiosk auto-resets to idle after 15 seconds on order completion screen
QR Code tab now has 'Self-Service Kiosk Mode' section with Copy Link buttons for each outlet
AI Upsell button in POS cart panel triggers AI suggestions panel with + buttons to add items
